entities.summary: Adiljan Suleyman is a Chinese former professional basketball player. Adiljan last played and coached for the Bayi Rockets, a Chinese Basketball Association team based in Ningbo. He is a Point guard. He is 1.80 m in height and he weighs 88 kg. Adijan competed at the 1992 Olympic Basketball Tournament for Team China.
